automations.name: codex-home-health-report

scope.write_boundary: report only; do not modify source, build, live or remote systems

automations.stop_condition: stop after report generation or after two consecutive health-check failures

run_lifecycle.first_run: manual review of health summary before any recurring use
run_lifecycle.steady_state: produce a dated report and stop without modifying source, build, live or remote systems
run_lifecycle.stale_after: one business day or two consecutive health-check failures
cleanup: discard transient command logs after summary
keep only action queue and verification command list
run_lifecycle.retention: retain report summary only when user asks to archive it

automations.name: external-feedback-triage

scope.write_boundary: draft only; never send, submit, merge, delete or publish

automations.stop_condition: stop when authorization expires, source access changes or the thread is handed off

run_lifecycle.first_run: manual review of approved data sources and draft-only boundary
run_lifecycle.steady_state: refresh approved summaries, draft responses and stop at human approval gates
run_lifecycle.stale_after: authorization expiry, source access change or 30 minutes without new signal
cleanup: remove stale draft replies after handoff
keep unresolved questions in the action queue
run_lifecycle.retention: retain only sanitized action queue or archived research note

automations.name: official-docs-watch

scope.write_boundary: research note only; no config, manifest or memory writes without a separate task

automations.stop_condition: stop after producing a dated change note or when official sources cannot be verified

run_lifecycle.first_run: manual review of official source scope and citation requirements
run_lifecycle.steady_state: check official sources, produce a dated note and route reusable items to review
run_lifecycle.stale_after: one week or when official sources cannot be verified
cleanup: do not keep raw page dumps
route reusable conclusions to archive or memory candidate review
run_lifecycle.retention: retain dated note only when source links and retrieval date are present

automations.name: local-runtime-boundary-review
automations.cadence: weekly Monday 10:00 Asia/Hong_Kong after explicit authorization

scope.write_boundary: report only; do not edit source, live config, rules or hook files

automations.stop_condition: stop after producing a boundary report, when config/rules drift is detected, or after two validation failures

run_lifecycle.first_run: manual review of local-only scope, disabled hook status and report-only boundary
run_lifecycle.steady_state: inspect local manifests and config, produce a sanitized report, then stop
run_lifecycle.stale_after: one week, Codex CLI version change or config/rules drift
cleanup: discard transient command logs after summary
keep only drift summary and command list
run_lifecycle.retention: retain sanitized boundary report only when user asks to archive it

automations.name: knowledge-hub-health-report

scope.write_boundary: report only; do not modify, promote, delete, publish, commit or write memories

automations.stop_condition: stop after one report or if registry cannot be parsed

run_lifecycle.first_run: manual review of Knowledge Hub source scope and report-only boundary
run_lifecycle.steady_state: run knowledge-check, summarize findings and stop without modifying knowledge sources
run_lifecycle.stale_after: one week or when registry schema changes
cleanup: discard transient command logs after summary
keep only health summary and action queue
run_lifecycle.retention: retain report summary only when user asks to archive it

automations.name: knowledge-hub-promotion-candidates
automations.cadence: monthly first Monday 09:30 Asia/Hong_Kong after explicit authorization

scope.write_boundary: report only; do not promote, move, delete or edit source material

automations.stop_condition: stop after producing candidate report or if source registry is invalid

run_lifecycle.first_run: manual review of promotion criteria and rejection rules
run_lifecycle.stale_after: one month or registry schema change
cleanup: do not keep raw private notes in report

automations.name: monthly-workflow-mining-report
automations.cadence: monthly first Monday 10:00 Asia/Hong_Kong after explicit authorization

data_sources: ~/.codex/sessions recent task summaries and only necessary raw evidence
~/codex manifests and managed skill, agent, automation and workflow inventory
Chronicle discovery only when exposed; confirm important facts in original systems
scope.write_boundary: report only; do not create or update skills, agents, automations, memories, archives or source files

automations.stop_condition: stop after one rolling 30-day report or when a required source cannot be parsed safely

allowed_outputs: create, extend, skip and needs-more-evidence decisions

run_lifecycle.first_run: manually review the rolling window, source scope, redaction boundary and existing-asset inventory
run_lifecycle.steady_state: inspect the previous 30 days, produce a sanitized candidate-first report and stop
run_lifecycle.stale_after: one month or when a history, memory, Chronicle or manifest schema changes
cleanup: discard raw session excerpts and attachment contents after aggregation
keep only sanitized evidence counts, source references and decisions
run_lifecycle.retention: retain only user-reviewed report summaries; never copy raw logs, sessions or private attachments

automations.name: local-daily-activity-report
automations.cadence: daily 20:30 Asia/Hong_Kong; external systemd user timer explicitly authorized 2026-08-02

scope.write_boundary: write only hash-bound facts v2 and Markdown under ~/knowledge-hub/.tmp/activity; do not modify knowledge, source, Codex runtime or memory

automations.stop_condition: stop after one report, on v2 schema/privacy failure, or when explicit subject configuration is missing

forbidden_actions: read old activity schemas, raw sessions, logs, cache, auth or raw memory
infer subject identity from Git, paths, memory or chat context
promote active facts or close owner gates

run_lifecycle.first_run: manually inspect source coverage, privacy flags, report hashes and systemd unit status
run_lifecycle.steady_state: generate one deterministic personal daily report from v2 subject-bound items at 20:30 Asia/Hong_Kong and stop
run_lifecycle.stale_after: two calendar days without a successful receipt
cleanup: do not automatically delete previous local reports
run_lifecycle.retention: retain local .tmp/activity artifacts according to the configured retention window; cleanup remains separately reviewed

automations.name: local-weekly-activity-report
automations.cadence: weekly Friday 20:45 Asia/Hong_Kong; external systemd user timer explicitly authorized 2026-08-02

scope.write_boundary: write only hash-bound facts v2 and Markdown under ~/knowledge-hub/.tmp/activity; do not modify knowledge, source, Codex runtime or memory

automations.stop_condition: stop after one Friday report, on v2 schema/privacy failure, or when explicit subject configuration is missing

forbidden_actions: read old activity schemas, raw sessions, logs, cache, auth or raw memory
infer subject identity from Git, paths, memory or chat context
promote active facts or close owner gates

run_lifecycle.first_run: manually inspect the Friday period, source coverage, privacy flags, report hashes and systemd unit status
run_lifecycle.steady_state: generate one Monday-to-Friday personal report from v2 subject-bound items at Friday 20:45 Asia/Hong_Kong and stop
run_lifecycle.stale_after: eight calendar days without a successful receipt
cleanup: do not automatically delete previous local reports
run_lifecycle.retention: retain local .tmp/activity artifacts according to the configured retention window; cleanup remains separately reviewed
